title.zh: 复盘：共鸣停在哪个具体瞬间
title.en: Review the particular moment you recognise

paragraphs.zh: 回到第一次手工的帖子，选一句只回应作品或过程的话，再比较“我也遇过这一步”和“我完全懂你”的不同。前者给交流留空间，后者可能超出帖子实际说出的内容。可以只写草稿，不必发布或讲自己的私事。复盘看有没有回应当时分享的重点，以及对方是否想继续；没有回复也先保留未知，不用更私人的故事换回应。
paragraphs.en: For the first craft post, draft a reply about the object or process and compare “I have met that step too” with “I understand you completely.” The first leaves room; the second may exceed what was shared. Draft privately without personal disclosure. Review the post’s actual focus and whether further conversation is wanted. An absent reply can remain unknown without offering a more private story to obtain one.

title.zh: 分享一个梗图角度，不替真人贴标签
title.en: Share a meme angle without labelling a person

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友晒出和教程不太一样的手工，你会回应哪个具体瞬间，又怎样避免替对方定义感受？”用虚构兴趣场景交换两种回应，也可以换个角度，不要求公开发帖或作出改变。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend shared a craft unlike the tutorial, which particular moment would you acknowledge without defining their feelings?” Exchange possible responses to a fictional hobby scene or choose another angle without posting publicly or making a change.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。六个名称是本版的娱乐读法，不判断年龄、心理健康、政治、智力或思考能力；对方可以不熟悉梗、不接受名称、不回答或结束。不要拿结果嘲讽自己或他人，也不根据帖子替不在场的人做测试。
paragraphs.en: Share this public guide without answers or counts in its link. Six names are this edition’s entertainment readings, establishing no age, mental health, politics, intelligence or thinking ability. The other person may be unfamiliar with the meme, reject a name, decline or stop. Use no result to demean yourself or others, or to assess an absent person from their posts.

title.zh: 复盘：小可能还能保持可选吗
title.en: Review whether the small possibility stays optional

paragraphs.zh: 回到过长的兴趣清单，选一件仍想试的事，再写下愿意花的时间和允许停止的地方。比较“也许今晚试十分钟”和“从此每天坚持”的不同；前者不需要变成后者才有价值。可以只圈一个点子，不必实际开始。复盘关注这次是否有乐趣和余力，休息、换活动或不继续都不由梗图名称评成退步。
paragraphs.en: For the overlong hobby list, choose an idea alongside time you would offer and a stopping point. Compare perhaps trying ten minutes tonight with committing every day. The first need not become the second to matter. Circle an idea without starting it. Review enjoyment and capacity for this occasion; resting, changing activities or stopping is no decline certified by a meme name.

title.zh: 分享一个梗图角度，不替真人贴标签
title.en: Share a meme angle without labelling a person

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果一张兴趣清单开始像作业，你想留下哪个小点子，怎样让不做或做一会儿就停也合理？”用虚构兴趣场景交换两种回应，也可以换个角度，不要求公开发帖或作出改变。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a hobby list began to feel like homework, which small idea would you keep and how could skipping or stopping shortly remain reasonable?” Exchange possible responses to a fictional hobby scene or choose another angle without posting publicly or making a change.

title.zh: 复盘：质疑的是哪一个承诺
title.en: Review the specific promise being questioned

paragraphs.zh: 沿用“一个技巧改变每次创作”的标题，把夸大的结果和可试的小做法分开。想一个关于材料、时间或适用情境的问题，再写一句不评价喜欢它的人的回应。可以只比较标题，不必进评论区争论。复盘关注说法有没有更准确，不看谁更冷静或谁赢了；觉得小做法好玩，也不要求接受整段宣传。
paragraphs.en: For the headline claiming one trick transforms every session, separate the oversized outcome from a small method to try. Draft a question about materials, time or context and a response that does not judge those enjoying it. Compare headlines without entering a comment argument. Review precision rather than composure or winning. Enjoying the method does not require accepting the whole pitch.

title.zh: 分享一个梗图角度，不替真人贴标签
title.en: Share a meme angle without labelling a person

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果兴趣帖把一个小技巧说得无所不能，你会问哪个具体问题，同时给别人喜欢它留空间？”用虚构兴趣场景交换两种回应，也可以换个角度，不要求公开发帖或作出改变。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a hobby post promised everything from one small trick, which specific question would you ask while leaving others room to enjoy it?” Exchange possible responses to a fictional hobby scene or choose another angle without posting publicly or making a change.

title.zh: 复盘：熟悉的乐趣能不能讲给陌生人听
title.en: Review whether the familiar pleasure is explainable

paragraphs.zh: 回到老游戏，把仍喜欢的一处玩法或声音说清，再想象听者从没接触过它。补一条能理解的描述，而不是考对方知不知道出处。也可以把同一细节放进新版本，看看喜欢的是熟悉感还是做法本身。只需想象，不必购买、重玩或放弃旧爱好；复盘关注交流是否有入口，不证明哪一代更懂品味。
paragraphs.en: For the older game, name a mechanic or sound you still enjoy and imagine a listener unfamiliar with it. Add an understandable description rather than testing recognition. Imagine the same detail in a newer version to distinguish familiarity from the feature itself. No purchase, replay or abandonment of a favourite is needed. Review an entrance to conversation without ranking generations’ taste.

title.zh: 分享一个梗图角度，不替真人贴标签
title.en: Share a meme angle without labelling a person

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果别人没玩过你喜欢的老游戏，你会先讲哪个具体乐趣，再邀请对方举一个自己的例子？”用虚构兴趣场景交换两种回应，也可以换个角度，不要求公开发帖或作出改变。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If someone had never played your favourite older game, which pleasure would you explain before inviting their own example?” Exchange possible responses to a fictional hobby scene or choose another angle without posting publicly or making a change.

title.zh: 复盘：新格式改变了什么，没改变什么
title.en: Review what the new format changes and leaves intact

paragraphs.zh: 沿用每周记录的一条试写，比较旧格式和新格式各能表达什么、读起来怎样，以及是否多了不想承担的步骤。可以只画示意，不必注册工具或迁移笔记。复盘关注这条内容是否更好表达；保留旧版、混用或不用新格式，都是可用结论，不用熟练度、流行程度或尝试次数证明自己年轻或懂互联网。
paragraphs.en: For one weekly entry, compare what the old and new formats express, their readability and unwanted extra steps. Sketch without registering a tool or moving notes. Review this entry’s expression. Keeping the old version, mixing formats or declining the new one are useful outcomes without proving youth or internet expertise through fluency, popularity or repeated trials.

title.zh: 分享一个梗图角度，不替真人贴标签
title.en: Share a meme angle without labelling a person

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果用新格式记录一次普通爱好，你想试哪个变化，又会保留旧版中的什么？”用虚构兴趣场景交换两种回应，也可以换个角度，不要求公开发帖或作出改变。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If recording an ordinary pastime in a new format, which change would you try and what would you retain from the old version?” Exchange possible responses to a fictional hobby scene or choose another angle without posting publicly or making a change.

title.zh: 复盘：流程留下了哪些自主选择
title.en: Review the choices a routine leaves available

paragraphs.zh: 回到每周固定帖，写出一个步骤的当前用途，再给它三个版本：保留、缩短和这次跳过。看看哪种更服务自己想做的活动，而非哪种看起来更特别。可以只修改草稿，不必发帖。复盘关注用途和选择是否仍然清楚；喜欢重复不证明没有思想，换格式也不认证独立，更不把这个梗图名用于否定任何真实的人。
paragraphs.en: For the weekly thread, state a step’s present purpose and imagine keeping, shortening or skipping it this time. Compare service to your activity rather than apparent originality. Revise a draft without posting. Review clear purpose and available choices. Enjoying repetition establishes no absence of thought, and changing formats certifies no independence. The meme name supplies no judgment of a real person.

paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a hobby-recording step repeated weekly, which purpose would you retain and when would you choose to modify or skip it?” Exchange possible responses to a fictional hobby scene or choose another angle without posting publicly or making a change.
